## Requirement 9: audits filed

Each repository was audited against this issue, the two pipeline templates and hive-mind `docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md`. Findings already covered by open issues were left out and cross-referenced. The key claims were re-checked with `gh` before filing.

| Repository | Issue | Headline findings |
|---|---|---|
| link-assistant/router | link-assistant/router#760 | Release 1.24.0 stuck in partial publication; delivery check failed 20 of its last 25 runs on `main` (last success 2026-10-05) with no alert; no link check, workflow lint, CodeQL, dependency review or cargo-deny; no SECURITY.md or templates |
| link-foundation/meta-language | link-foundation/meta-language#221 | `CI`: 0 green in the last 100 runs (54 failed, 46 cancelled), `main` red; the ruleset requires no checks; Rust is mostly hand-written (122,747 lines vs 48,042 JS); no pre-push validation or push gate. The JS→Rust `needs:` gate and the parity gate already work. |
| link-foundation/relative-meta-logic | link-foundation/relative-meta-logic#187 | JS and Rust jobs run in parallel with no gate; `main` unprotected; parity is corpus output only; meta-language versions differ (crate 0.49.0, npm ^0.46.0); no release, link or security pipelines; #184 acceptance 0 of 23 green |
| link-assistant/formal-ai | link-assistant/formal-ai#1191 | Rust jobs ungated; the "js" tier is `node --check` only; Layered CI passes `skipped`; the ruleset has no required checks; `Self-development status` red on `main` every day from 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-09; PR #1188 0 green |
| link-foundation/link-cli | link-foundation/link-cli#111 | Rust, C# and WASM ungated; no parity across three implementations; `main` unprotected; 8 stale 2025 PRs; #109 red |
| link-foundation/links-notation | link-foundation/links-notation#339 | Six language workflows ungated; 7 hand-written implementations with no shared fixtures; Java publish reports success but Maven Central has 0 artifacts; `main` unprotected; 6 stale PRs |
| link-foundation/start | link-foundation/start#197 | `rust.yml` not gated on `js.yml`; parity is a test-count heuristic; no cargo build-load settings; no agent or contributor docs; `main` unprotected |
| link-assistant/calculator | link-assistant/calculator#254 | No native JS implementation (the web UI calls WASM only); `release.yml` is the only CI and runs Rust first; ESLint and e2e not in CI; template gaps |

Common gaps across almost all of them: no JavaScript gate in front of Rust, no required status checks on `main`, no data-driven parity manifest (meta-language has one), hand-written Rust instead of meta-language translation, and no agent rules for bulk drafting with a single push gate.
